description: D-076: the files of the judging tooling (the tool root, the base tip's under the pin) that run a script test or a stage and decide its result: the part of gate_version a cached result depends on. Their content is in every script-test and stage key (gate_keys.key_parts), so a change to how the gate runs a test misses every cache while a change to the code under test misses only the tests that read it.
